title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Building a Socialist Harmonious Society
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Building a Socialist Harmonious Society"

Fa Fa [2007] No. 2

To all local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In the process of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and building a socialist harmonious society, the people's courts bear a major historical mission. In order to better implement the strategic deployment of the Party Central Committee, fully leverage the functional role of the people's courts, and provide strong judicial guarantees for building a socialist harmonious society, the Supreme People's Court has formulated the "Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Building a Socialist Harmonious Society," which are hereby issued to you. Please conscientiously implement them in trial work in light of actual circumstances.

January 15, 2007

Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Building a Socialist Harmonious Society

The Sixth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China adopted the "Decision on Several Major Issues Concerning Building a Socialist Harmonious Society," which is a major strategic deployment made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary for building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and accelerating socialist modernization. In order to better implement the Decision, fully leverage the functional role of the people's courts, and provide strong judicial guarantees for building a socialist harmonious society, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

I. Providing Judicial Guarantees for Building a Socialist Harmonious Society Is a Major Historical Mission of the People's Courts

1. A socialist harmonious society is a society of democracy and the rule of law, fairness and justice, honesty and fraternity, vitality, stability and order, and harmony between man and nature. These basic features of a harmonious society are closely related to the work of the people's courts. The fundamental duty of the people's courts is to resolve social conflicts, maintain social stability, safeguard economic development, promote social harmony, and achieve fairness and justice. The people's courts are not only a force for building a harmonious society, but also a force for guaranteeing a harmonious society. They bear a major historical mission in the process of building a socialist harmonious society.

2. The strategic deployment of building a socialist harmonious society places higher and newer demands on the people's courts, adds more and more difficult tasks, and imposes greater and heavier responsibilities. Due to profound social changes, a large number of acute and complex social conflicts have transformed into criminal offenses, civil disputes, and administrative disputes entering the judicial arena. Many deep-seated contradictions and problems touched upon in the reform process need to be resolved through judicial procedures. The process by which the people's courts provide judicial guarantees for a harmonious society is a process of continuously exerting their functional role, resolving conflicts, and promoting harmony. To fulfill the heavy responsibilities they bear, the people's courts must change their mindsets, raise their work standards, focus on social harmony, commit to social harmony, and treat the provision of judicial guarantees for a harmonious society as a long-term historical task and a major practical issue to be firmly grasped.

II. Guiding Ideology, Objectives and Tasks, and Basic Principles

3. To provide judicial guarantees for building a socialist harmonious society, we must adhere to Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents" as guidance, comprehensively implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, uphold the guiding principle of "impartial justice, wholehearted service to the people" and the work theme of "justice and efficiency," take resolving social conflicts as the entry point, ensuring social stability as the focal point, safeguarding the interests of the people as the starting point, and upholding judicial justice as the foothold. By fully and effectively exerting functional roles in accordance with the law, we must maximize factors conducive to harmony and minimize factors detrimental to harmony, striving to provide a stable and orderly social environment and a fair, efficient, and authoritative rule-of-law environment for a socialist harmonious society.

4. The main objectives and tasks for providing judicial guarantees for building a socialist harmonious society are: By the year 2020, the socialist trial system and working mechanisms will be more complete, judicial activities will be more just, efficient, and authoritative; the judicial functions of maintaining fairness and justice and promoting coordinated economic and social development will be more robust; judicial means for resolving social conflicts will be more diverse, and judicial methods will be more convenient; judicial protection of human rights will be more adequate, and the litigation rights of the people will be genuinely respected and safeguarded; judicial openness and transparency will be significantly enhanced, and judicial democracy will be basically established; the quality of judges will be markedly improved, and the professionalization of judges will be basically realized; the capacity and level of guarantees will be significantly strengthened, and the judicial needs of a harmonious society will be further satisfied.

5. To provide judicial guarantees for building a socialist harmonious society, the following principles must be adhered to: First, uphold impartial justice. Always regard impartial justice as the soul and life of all work of the people's courts, as the fundamental task of providing guarantees, adhere to judicial independence and neutrality, uphold equal protection, and through fair, efficient, and authoritative justice in accordance with the law, maximize the maintenance and realization of social fairness and justice. Second, uphold wholehearted service to the people. Always regard safeguarding the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of the people as the starting point and foothold of all work of the people's courts, as the fundamental content of providing guarantees, and in accordance with the requirement of justice for the people, properly handle issues concerning the interests that the people are most concerned about, most directly affected by, and most practical. Third, uphold serving the overall situation. Always regard maintaining the overall situation of reform, development, and stability as the central task of all work of the people's courts, as the fundamental way to provide guarantees, fully leverage functional roles, and create a good rule-of-law environment. Fourth, uphold the leadership of the Party. Always regard the leadership of the Party as the political requirement for all work of the people's courts, as the fundamental guarantee for providing guarantees, consciously accept the supervision of the People's Congress and its Standing Committee, and maintain the political nature of the court contingent being forever loyal to the Party, the state, the people, and the law.

III. Resolving Social Conflicts and Promoting Social Harmony

6. Properly adjudicate marriage and family cases and community neighborhood dispute cases, and promote harmony in marriage, family, and community neighborhood relations. In adjudicating marriage and family dispute cases, advocate traditional virtues such as freedom of marriage, equality between men and women, respect for the elderly and love for the young, and mutual assistance; punish in accordance with the law illegal acts such as domestic violence, abandonment and abuse of the elderly and children, and failure to fulfill the duty of support and maintenance. In adjudicating community neighborhood disputes, advocate moral trends such as mutual respect, mutual assistance, environmental care, and civilized conduct; punish in accordance with the law illegal acts such as damaging the environment and destroying public property.

7. Properly adjudicate cases involving agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, and maintain harmony in rural society. Strengthen the filing, trial, and enforcement work of cases involving agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, further facilitate litigation for farmers; adjudicate various types of rural land contract dispute cases in accordance with the law, safeguard the various land contract and management rights and interests of farmers; adjudicate administrative cases involving agriculture, such as arbitrary charges, arbitrary apportionments, land expropriation, and resettlement compensation, in accordance with the law, protect the lawful rights and interests of farmers; punish in accordance with the law crimes that harm farmers' interests, such as production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy pesticides, veterinary drugs, fertilizers, and seeds, as well as crimes that undermine rural democratic management, such as election sabotage, and maintain normal economic and social order in rural areas.

8. Properly adjudicate labor dispute cases, and maintain harmony in labor relations. Actively accept cases involving violations of workers' lawful rights and interests, such as enterprises defaulting on or withholding wages, regulate enterprises' employment practices, and promote the development and improvement of the labor market. Strengthen the protection of the lawful rights and interests of migrant workers, ensuring that they receive due labor remuneration in a timely manner.

9. Properly adjudicate administrative cases and state compensation cases, and promote harmony in relations between administrative organs, judicial organs, and citizens, legal persons, and other organizations. Fully leverage the important role of administrative litigation in resolving administrative disputes, insist on accepting administrative cases in accordance with the law, smooth relief channels, guide parties to express their claims through statutory litigation procedures, and prevent the escalation of conflicts; adjudicate mass administrative cases in accordance with the law, properly coordinate the relationship between administrative subjects and administrative counterparts, support and ensure that administrative organs exercise their powers in accordance with the law, and protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations. Adjudicate state compensation cases in accordance with the law, provide relief and compensation to citizens who have suffered unlawful infringement by state organs, and supervise and promote state organs to exercise their powers in accordance with the law.

10. Properly adjudicate environmental tort cases, and promote harmony between man and nature. Increase the intensity of adjudicating disputes involving resources and the environment, severely punish in accordance with the law illegal activities that pollute the environment and destroy resources, such as major environmental pollution accidents, illegal mining, illegal logging, illegal occupation of agricultural land, and illegal hunting, and promote the establishment and improvement of a social circular economy system, a resource development and utilization compensation mechanism, and an ecological environment restoration compensation mechanism.

IV. Regulating Economic Relations and Ensuring Social Development

11. Properly adjudicate cases involving the reform of state-owned enterprises, and promote the improvement of the basic economic system. Prudently handle civil disputes arising during the restructuring of state-owned enterprises, protect the lawful rights and interests of creditors and enterprise employees; properly adjudicate bankruptcy cases of state-owned enterprises, reduce bankruptcy expenses, lower bankruptcy costs, actively recover claims of bankrupt enterprises, and increase the claim repayment rate; actively prevent and properly handle mass incidents caused by enterprise bankruptcy, achieve careful case filing, meticulous trial, and stable enforcement, and maintain enterprise and social stability.

12. Properly adjudicate financial dispute cases, and ensure financial security. Strictly control the conditions for accepting bankruptcy cases of financial institutions, ensure effective linkage between the bankruptcy procedures of financial institutions and administrative revocation, closure, and rectification procedures; prudently handle cases involving the disposal of non-performing financial assets, ensure the safety and smoothness of non-performing asset disposal transactions, strengthen the review of the validity of non-performing asset transfer contracts, and prevent the loss of state assets.

13. Properly adjudicate commercial dispute cases, and promote the establishment of a social credit system. Strengthen the adjudication of contract dispute cases, adhere to the principles of freedom of contract and good faith, encourage honest transactions, punish breaches of contract and torts, and ensure transaction safety; strengthen the adjudication of cases involving capital market disputes, establish and improve the civil liability system for securities torts, protect the lawful rights and interests of investors, especially small and medium investors, regulate the order of the securities market, and ensure the stable operation of the securities market.

14. Properly adjudicate intellectual property dispute cases, and ensure the creativity and innovation capacity of the whole society. Increase the protection of scientific and technological achievements and copyrights, stop infringements such as piracy and patent infringement, stimulate innovation, promote the prosperity of science, technology, literature, and art, and promote the rapid development of the knowledge economy; stop in accordance with the law acts of infringing on the exclusive right to use registered trademarks and unfair competition, promote brand innovation, maintain business ethics, and guide the establishment of a fair and orderly market competition order; accept in accordance with the law intellectual property dispute cases involving the internet, strengthen intellectual property protection in the internet environment; strengthen in accordance with the law criminal punishment and civil sanctions for intellectual property infringement, and maximize the protection of the lawful rights and interests of rights holders.

15. Properly adjudicate cases involving foreign elements, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, and maritime and commercial cases, and enhance the international credibility of Chinese justice. Adhere to the principles of equal protection, legal unity, judicial independence, and transparency, correctly exercise judicial jurisdiction, accurately apply Chinese law, foreign law, international conventions, and international practices, and equally protect the lawful rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties; strengthen judicial supervision over foreign-related commercial and maritime arbitration, and promote the healthy development of the arbitration industry in accordance with the law.

V. Combining Leniency and Severity, Ensuring Social Stability

16. Severely crack down on serious criminal offenses in accordance with the law, and safeguard national security and social stability. Severely punish in accordance with the law crimes endangering national security, terrorist crimes, and organized crimes of a mafia nature; severely punish in accordance with the law crimes seriously endangering public security and seriously affecting the safety of the masses, such as explosions, murder, robbery, and kidnapping; property crimes of a multiple nature such as robbery and theft; drug crimes; crimes of abducting and trafficking women and children; punish in accordance with the law crimes of major liability in production activities, and ensure social stability and the people's peaceful life; crack down on in accordance with the law crimes of producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, and protect the life and health of the people; punish in accordance with the law crimes such as smuggling, financial fraud, money laundering, illegal absorption of public deposits, counterfeiting currency, defrauding export tax rebates, falsely issuing special VAT invoices, tax evasion, and tax resistance, and maintain the order of the socialist market economy; severely punish in accordance with the law duty crimes such as corruption, bribery, and dereliction of duty, punish in accordance with the law commercial bribery crimes, and promote the deep development of the anti-corruption struggle.

17. Strengthen the protection of human rights in the field of criminal justice. Respect in accordance with the law the personal dignity of the accused, protect the litigation rights enjoyed by the accused in accordance with the law, fully hear the opinions of the accused and their defenders, and ensure that the accused receives a lawful, fair, and civilized trial; adhere to the unity of correctness in substantive handling and legitimacy of procedural process, both insist on the principle of emphasizing evidence and not readily relying on confessions, effectively ensure that the facts of the case are clear and the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and also adhere to the principles of legality and proportionality of punishment, effectively ensure accurate conviction and appropriate sentencing, and ensure that innocent persons are not subject to criminal prosecution.

18. Be lenient when leniency is warranted, and minimize social antagonism to the greatest extent. Pay attention to applying non-custodial penalties in accordance with the law; for minor crimes, etc., where subjective malignancy and personal danger are not great and the accused shows repentance and obtains the victim's forgiveness, give them as much opportunity as possible to reform, impose lighter or mitigated punishment in accordance with the law, and apply non-custodial penalties such as probation, public surveillance, and fines alone when conditions are met, and cooperate with community correction work; pay attention to applying non-penalty punishment methods; for minor crimes where punishment is not necessary, impose reprimands or orders to repent, apologize, compensate for losses, or recommend that the competent authority impose administrative sanctions or disciplinary measures. Strictly implement the policy of "retaining the death penalty but strictly controlling its application"; for those with statutory circumstances for lighter or mitigated punishment, impose lighter or mitigated punishment in accordance with the law, and generally do not impose the death penalty with immediate execution; for cases arising from the escalation of civil conflicts such as marriage, family, and neighborhood disputes, cases arising from the fault of the victim, and cases where the offender genuinely repents and actively compensates the victim after the incident, the death penalty with immediate execution should be applied with caution.

19. Actively participate in comprehensive social security management. For minors who commit crimes, adhere to the policy of education, persuasion, and rescue, combine education with trial and punishment, strive for better correction results, effectively prevent recidivism, and promote their early return to society; strictly handle commutation and parole cases in accordance with the law; if the criminal is truly unlikely to harm society again based on the circumstances of the crime and the degree of repentance, the application of parole may be appropriately expanded to promote the reformation and rehabilitation of criminals; actively make judicial suggestions in response to security risks and management loopholes discovered in trials; combine trial work to carry out legal education and publicity activities, and comprehensively enhance the legal awareness of the whole society.

VI. Strengthening Institutional Construction and Improving Guarantee Mechanisms

20. Strengthen litigation mediation and improve diversified dispute resolution mechanisms. Adhere to the principle of "mediate when possible, adjudicate when necessary, combine mediation and adjudication, and close the case with resolution," increase the proportion of disputes resolved through mediation, guide parties to reach agreements on a voluntary and mutual concession basis, and reduce confrontation between parties; broaden the scope of application of litigation mediation, try new models of mediation for private criminal prosecution cases and other minor criminal cases, increase the intensity of mediation in criminal incidental civil cases, explore administrative litigation settlement systems, and promote settlement in enforcement; strengthen guidance to people's mediation committees, and support people's mediation committees in playing an important role in mediating disputes and resolving conflicts.

21. Improve the judicial assistance system and demonstrate judicial humanistic care. Fully pay attention to the judicial needs of the impoverished masses, improve the specific conditions and standards for deferring, reducing, and exempting litigation costs for parties with financial difficulties; for parties who are economically distressed in pursuing claims for child support, maintenance, personal injury compensation, and labor remuneration, as well as special disadvantaged groups such as migrant workers, laid-off workers, the elderly living alone, and persons with disabilities, actively take measures to defer, reduce, or exempt litigation costs to ensure that parties meeting assistance conditions can afford to litigate; study the establishment of a state relief system for criminal victims; for defendants who are blind, deaf, mute, or have limited capacity for civil conduct, who are under 18 years of age at the time of trial opening, who may be sentenced to death, and who have not appointed a defender, the people's court shall appoint a defender for them.

22. Improve circuit trial, implement the system of informing parties of their rights and obligations, and facilitate litigation for the masses. Consolidate and improve the working mechanism for direct case filing by people's tribunals; based on local population distribution and case volume, establish fixed circuit trial points outside the location of people's tribunals, and send personnel to regularly conduct trials at these circuit trial points; in rural areas, implement mobile case handling, file cases on the spot, adjudicate on the spot, mediate promptly, and pronounce judgments at the appropriate time; adopt flexible and diverse forms to resolve civil disputes and resolve conflicts at the grassroots level. Implement the system of informing parties of their rights and obligations, strengthen oral notification for impoverished masses or parties with low educational levels, and prevent "formalism" and "superficiality" in the notification process.

23. Expand the scope of application of summary procedures and improve judicial efficiency. Further standardize the application of summary procedures, achieve the separation of complex and simple cases; study and explore fast-track procedure systems and plea bargaining systems, and try fast handling mechanisms for small-claim litigation cases.

24. Improve the enforcement working mechanism, strengthen and improve enforcement work. Establish an enforcement working mechanism with unified management, unified coordination, and efficient operation, resist interference from local protectionism and departmental protectionism; promote enforcement transparency, expand enforcement methods, improve enforcement measures, and maximize the realization of the rights of prevailing parties; strengthen the construction of a national enforcement deterrence mechanism to promote automatic performance of effective judgments by parties; establish an enforcement relief fund for the impoverished masses to provide convenience and assistance for them to realize their claims; scientifically define the boundaries of enforcement powers, standardize enforcement conduct, strengthen enforcement management, and effectively achieve lawful and civilized enforcement.

25. Strengthen judicial democracy construction and increase judicial transparency. Improve the open trial system, achieving openness in case filing, court hearings, judgment results, and enforcement processes; consciously accept social supervision, regularly invite people's congress deputies and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference to observe court hearings, and seriously listen to their opinions and suggestions; improve the people's陪审员 system, and give play to the role of people's jurors in judicial mediation and judgments; respect the status of lawyers in litigation, and ensure the legitimate rights of lawyers in case file review and court hearings.

26. Improve the work mechanism for litigation-related petitions and perfect the system for appeals and applications for retrial. Establish a unified coordination mechanism and information management system for handling litigation-related petition cases nationwide, clarify the division of labor and responsibilities between higher and lower courts in receiving and handling litigation-related petitions, and prevent mutual buck-passing or repeated review; promote the hearing system for review of retrials, increase transparency in the review of appeals and applications for retrial, and improve the efficiency of appeal review; guide parties to prudently exercise their right to appeal and apply for retrial, and express their claims in accordance with the law; through clear procedural arrangements, standardize the review conduct for appeals and applications for retrial; for cases that meet the conditions for retrial, resolutely conduct retrials in accordance with the law, ensuring timely and fair handling of cases applying for retrial.

VII. Strengthening Team Building and Enhancing Guarantee Capacity

27. Strengthen leadership team building. Select personnel with firm political stance, familiarity with legal practice, integrity and honesty, and meeting the qualifications prescribed by the Judges Law to be appointed to leadership positions in the people's courts; establish leadership mechanisms and working mechanisms that conform to the laws of adjudication, achieving an organic balance between adjudicative responsibilities and administrative management duties; continuously raise the leadership level and judicial capability of leading cadres, ensuring they are competent in adjudication, good at coordination, and skilled in management; diligently cultivate and select reserve candidates for leadership positions in the leadership team, forming a more rationally structured reserve cadre force.

28. Accelerate the professionalization of the judge corps. Strictly enforce professional access criteria for judges, improve the quality of judge selection, and actively implement the system of selecting judges for higher-level courts from among outstanding judges of lower-level courts; strengthen the professional awareness of judges, adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents," take the Scientific Outlook on Development as the guide, and firmly establish a correct outlook on life, worldview, and values; enhance the professional skills of judges, continuously improve their level of presiding over trial activities and their capacity for judicial protection; cultivate the professional image of judges, strive to strengthen the construction of judicial ethics, and continuously cultivate the professional quality of judges; strengthen professional safeguards for judges, and promote the establishment and improvement of systems for appointment, promotion, rewards, pensions, medical insurance, salaries, welfare, and allowances that are suited to the professional characteristics of judges.

29. Strengthen basic-level work. Implement the policy of preferential treatment for those at the basic level and those on the front line, tilting human, financial, and material resources towards basic-level people's courts, including people's tribunals, and towards the central and western regions; adopt effective measures to gradually resolve the problem of insufficient judge staffing; in conjunction with the reform of the national judicial examination system, advance the classified management of court personnel, alleviating the pressure on the corps caused by the "gap" of judges in the western regions; focus on strengthening training for presidents and judges of basic-level people's courts, especially those in the western regions; coordinate with financial departments to formulate and improve the standards for guaranteeing public expenses of basic-level people's courts, actively strive for increased transfer payments from central and provincial-level finances to courts in poverty-stricken areas, and expedite the completion of the construction of people's tribunals in the central and western regions.

30. Strengthen the construction of judicial integrity and clean government. Accept, in accordance with the law, the work supervision of the People's Congress and its Standing Committee, the legal supervision of the People's Procuratorates, and the democratic supervision from all sectors of society; establish a scientific internal power operation mechanism, fully leveraging the supervisory and restrictive functions of the litigation system itself; improve and perfect the self-discipline mechanism of "unwilling to commit misconduct," the disciplinary mechanism of "daring not to commit misconduct," the preventive mechanism of "unable to commit misconduct," and the guarantee mechanism of "unnecessary to commit misconduct"; focus on investigating and punishing persons and incidents involving the abuse of judicial and enforcement powers for personal gain, resolutely eliminate the "black sheep" within the judge corps, and uphold judicial integrity.

Section 8: Firmly Rely on the Leadership of the Party to Ensure the Correct Direction of the People's Courts' Work

31. Further enhance the concept of consciously accepting and relying on the Party's leadership, always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee politically, ideologically, and in action, consciously uphold the authority of the Central Committee, and ensure the unimpeded implementation of the Central Committee's decrees in the people's courts; adhere to the unity of the Party's leadership and the lawful exercise of functions and powers, adhere to the unity of implementing Party policies and implementing laws, and ensure that the work of the people's courts always advances in the correct political direction.

The people's courts bear heavy responsibilities in providing judicial guarantees for building a socialist harmonious society. We must live up to this mission, work solidly, seek truth and be pragmatic, blaze new trails, and strive diligently to build a socialist harmonious society.
